Dual-trope text — מ:כפול

← Back to Reading MAM-parsed-plus

This template encodes a dually-accented span of text and its corresponding singly-accented “strands.” Used in three sections with dual cantillation: the two Decalogues (Exodus 20, Deuteronomy 5) and the Saga of Reuben (Genesis 35:22).

{
  "tmpl_name": "מ:כפול",
  "tmpl_params": {
    "כפול": "...text with two accents on some words...",
    "א": "...strand 1 (singly-accented)...",
    "ב": "...strand 2 (singly-accented)..."
  }
}

Named parameters:

Param Description
כפול The text with dual accents (as found in the great codexes)
א First singly-accented strand (for Reuben: פשוטה; for Decalogues: תחתון cantillation)
ב Second singly-accented strand (for Reuben: מדרשית; for Decalogues: עליון cantillation)
